items.title: Comcast (CMCSA) Stock May Be A Bargain After Gaming Network News
items.summary: Comcast shares have climbed in the short term but are still well below where they were five years ago, which puts fresh focus on whether the current price really lines up with what the business earns. With the spotlight back on its connectivity and media assets, the core issue for you is how much of Comcast's earnings story is already baked into the US$25.73 share price. Over the past 5 years the stock has fallen 36.5%. The valuation question now turns on whether the market has simply reset...

items.title: Comcast (CMCSA) Expands Xfinity Fiber Network, Is It Still 9% Below Fair Value?
items.summary: Comcast (CMCSA) just expanded its multi gigabit, symmetrical, fiber powered Xfinity network to nearly 12,000 homes and businesses in Westport, extending access alongside more than 65 million existing locations. For investors watching Comcast, recent price action has been mixed. The share price has climbed about 16.6% over the past month and is up around 1.9% over the last week. items.title: Xfinity Price Increase Could Be A Game Changer For Comcast (CMCSA)
items.summary: Comcast recently confirmed that Xfinity customers will face price increases from December 2026 as the business seeks to cover higher costs and continue funding its network and service investments while contending with pressure in broadband and cable TV. The move highlights how Comcast is leaning more on pricing power and fee structures at a time when fixed wireless and fiber rivals are actively targeting its broadband and video base. items.title: Is Netflix Stock Worth More Than Its Competitors?
items.summary: Netflix (NFLX) keeps more of each sales dollar than almost every company in its peer group. Yet its stock is one of the cheapest in that group. Among five companies, Netflix ranks second on operating margin. It has the fourth-highest price to earnings ratio, which makes it the second cheapest. So is Netflix stock worth more than its competitors.
